review.assessment: This change introduces a stub implementation of `parseCsv` in solution.mjs that ignores all input and immediately returns an empty array. It contains no parsing logic to handle row splitting, line endings, quoted fields, escaped quotes, or newlines within fields. As a result, it completely fails the acceptance test which expects basic comma-separated values to be parsed into nested arrays.

findings.defect: parseCsv is a stub that always returns an empty array instead of parsing the input CSV string.
